title: viola tricolor var. luteola
intro: Viola tricolor var. luteola, commonly known as Wild Pansy, is a perennial flowering plant belonging to the violet family. The plant is known for its bright yellow flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Viola tricolor var. luteola include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cognitive function, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties.
